summary: Complete frontend testing of new encyclopedia content sections in Resources page (/ressources). All 5 encyclopedia tabs tested: Tableaux MP (20 diseases + 5 TMS cards), Hors tableau (2 paths + CRRMP procedure), IPP (definition + 10 examples + calculator link), MDPH directory (101 departments with search/click interaction), Aides MDPH (3 CMI cards + 6 PCH accordion items + AAH/RQTH cards). Existing FAQ and PDF library sections verified working.
passed_tests: Resources page loads at /ressources with hero section 'Comprendre pour mieux agir'
Glossary section shows 8 terms (IPP, PTIA, CRRMP, AT/MP, RQTH, MDPH, AAH, CMI)
Encyclopedia section visible with 5 tabs
Tab 'Tableaux MP' shows by default
Tab 'Tableaux MP': Official diseases table displays 20 rows with N°, Maladie, Délai columns
Tab 'Tableaux MP': TMS zoom section shows 5 localization cards (57A, 57B, 57C, 57D, 57E)
Tab 'Hors tableau': Shows 2 paths (Alinéa 3 - Maladie inscrite au tableau, Alinéa 4 - Maladie absente des tableaux)
Tab 'Hors tableau': CRRMP procedure shows 4 steps (Déclaration, Instruction CPAM, Examen CRRMP, Décision)
Tab 'IPP': Complete definition with 'Qu'est-ce que l'IPP?' section
Tab 'IPP': Shows indemnisation types - Capital forfaitaire (<10%) and Rente viagère (≥10%)
Tab 'IPP': 10 concrete examples with taux, description, indemnisation, consequences
Tab 'IPP': Link to IPP calculator (/calculatrice-ipp) present
Tab 'MDPH': Search input filters departments by number or name
Tab 'MDPH': All 101 departments listed (96 metro + 5 outre-mer: 971-976)
Tab 'MDPH': Clicking department shows detail card with address, phone, email, website
Tab 'MDPH': 'Retour' button returns to list from detail view
Tab 'Aides MDPH': CMI section shows 3 types (Invalidité, Priorité, Stationnement)
Tab 'Aides MDPH': PCH accordion with 6 aid types (humaine, technique, logement, véhicule, animalière, charges)
Tab 'Aides MDPH': AAH and RQTH summary cards with links to calculators
FAQ section works with category tabs (AT/MP, Expertises, Assurances, MDPH)
PDF library section displays 6 downloadable guides with download buttons
critical_code_review_comments: Excellent implementation with proper data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
Static data files well-structured (MALADIES_PRO_TABLEAUX: 20 entries, TMS_LOCALISATION: 5 entries, IPP_EXEMPLES: 10 entries, MDPH_DIRECTORY: 101 entries)
MdphFinder sub-component correctly uses useState for selected/query and useMemo for filtering
Tab navigation and accordion interactions work smoothly
All content is static data - no mocked APIs required

mocked_apis.note: No mocked APIs - all encyclopedia content is static data
